name: Coordinate-Graded Betti Formula for Ample Alexander Duals
statement: If $C$ is ample and $U\subseteq[n]$, then $\beta^S_{p,\mathbf1+\mathbf1_U}(J_C)=|\{V\in\operatorname{Sh}(C):U\subseteq V\}|$ for $p=|U|$ and is zero otherwise; all other coordinate-graded Betti numbers vanish. Consequently $\beta_p(J_C)=\sum_{V\in\operatorname{Sh}(C)}\binom{|V|}{p}$.
proof: The linear cellular resolution of the Alexander-dual ideal of an ample class has one step-$p$ basis element for each contained $p$-cube. A cube with direction set $U$ has coordinate degree $\mathbf1+\mathbf1_U$. Iterated two-section counting shows that the number of contained cubes in directions $U$ equals the number of shattered supports containing $U$: ampleness and the Sandwich theorem identify the shattered complex of each section intersection. Summing the multigraded formula over $U$ yields the total Betti number.
comments: Thus the ordinary Betti table, projective dimension, and regularity also depend only on the shattered complex. The conclusion does not cover the fully signed literal grading or maps among conditioned classes.
